description: The sum of non-heave and overall three-point percentages is nonnegative.
explanation: Both columns are percentages on a 0-to-1 scale, so each is intrinsically nonnegative; unlike an ordering claim, this bound remains valid when the overall rate is slightly above the non-heave rate due to the heave-inclusive denominator and finite shot outcomes.

description: Average shot quality and true-shooting percentage have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: Both are efficiency or probability-style rates reported on nonnegative scales.

description: Effective field-goal percentage and true-shooting percentage have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: Both efficiency percentages are nonnegative measures of scoring conversion.

description: Total points rate and usage rate have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: Both are nonnegative rate statistics: points cannot be negative and usage is a percentage of possessions.

description: Free-throw points rate and usage rate have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: Free-throw scoring and usage are both nonnegative possession-normalized quantities.

description: Putback points rate and usage rate have a nonnegative sum.
explanation: Putback scoring is a nonnegative scoring rate and usage is a nonnegative percentage.
